query: Run /build to execute the approved implementation plan.
expected_behavior: Reads implementation_plan.md and works through it one component at a time, not all at once
For each component, writes a failing test first, then the minimal code to make it pass (red then green)
Runs the linter and a security check after each component before moving to the next
Does not write code beyond what the current test requires (no speculative abstraction)
Routes to /debug after 2 consecutive failures on the same component instead of thrashing
Stops and reports when every component in the plan is implemented and its tests pass
